decisions.executionNote: Begin right-arm elbow-up approach toward mouse, lifting and pitching down gradually; left stays in its workspace.
Align right gripper vertically over mouse with open fingers, approaching from above using small continuous increments.
Lower around mouse and close right fingers; retention will be checked visually during lift.
Lift mouse with right gripper closed and carry toward center of black mouse pad; inspect visual retention.
Center mouse on pad, lower to surface, release and rise to inspect placement.
Mouse is on pad after release. Withdraw right arm and bring both arms above the keyboard's front edge, preserving elbow-up continuity.
Bring closed grippers to the keyboard's front corners for a controlled push. Lower slowly and keep both elbows up.
Set gripper tips at the keyboard edge, then make a short diagonal push toward its outlined frame and inspect motion.
Continue short controlled diagonal keyboard push; right advances slightly farther to keep its front edge square.
Keyboard yawed as left corner advanced; reposition right pusher behind its front-right edge while left holds stationary.
Square the keyboard by advancing only its right-front corner; left pusher stays still. Watch yaw and table contact.
Finish squaring keyboard while nudging it right toward the frame center; small right-biased forward push.
Nudge keyboard into final alignment, then open grippers and withdraw upward/backward without dragging it.
Keyboard remains aligned after release. Move left arm above figurine; right retreats toward its origin.
Align left open fingers around figurine's upper body; finish right-arm retreat, monitoring clearance.
Fine-align left fingers around figurine torso and close; settle before testing lift. Correct small right wrist residual at origin.
Test figurine retention with a gentle lift, then begin carrying toward the silver stand. Keep left gripper fully closed.
Carry figurine laterally clear of drawer before moving forward. Keep grasp closed; watch the off-center body/base offset.
Figurine did not follow the last carry. Reopen and reposition above it for a more centered top-down grasp; do not infer retention from commands.
Move open left gripper farther left over the displaced figurine, remaining above the head and using wrist RGB for alignment.
After continuity interruption, use much smaller translations and lower the high wrist while approaching figurine, avoiding further elbow folding.
Cautiously align farther forward and left around the figurine, lowering in small increments to stay away from the folded-arm limit.
Replan after IK rejection: back away from forward reach and use a shallower wrist angle for a front-side figurine grasp.
Use millimeter translations and very small wrist increments to recover continuously from the near-limit configuration.
Reverse the last accepted approach with submillimeter steps and fixed orientation to regain a continuous reachable configuration.
With continuity recovered, gradually shallow the wrist and lower/back the open gripper for a centered front-side grasp.
Lower open fingers around the narrower waist rather than shoulders, then close and pause before a retention test.
Test the new waist grasp with a small straight lift and slight lateral motion, checking that the figurine base follows.
Figurine did not lift. Reopen and advance lower/deeper around its waist instead of closing short of the body.
Close around the body at the deeper contact and test a small vertical lift before carrying.
Lift and ease figurine back clear of the drawer, testing whether its base follows the closed grasp during slow lateral motion.
Wrist RGB shows figurine retained. Carry it steadily rightward in front of the drawer, keeping orientation and closed grasp fixed.
Continue carrying retained figurine toward stand, gaining a little height to clear the nearby clock; remain left of center.
Move suspended figurine forward toward its silver stand while staying above the clock. Delay descent until base is clear.
Replan after guard with smaller forward increments and gentle descent to avoid the folded limit, keeping figurine above the clock.
Figurine rotated out of the grasp near the stand. Open and back away in small steps to regain joint margin and inspect its settled pose.
Clear the tipped figurine and approach the alarm clock from above with open fingers; removing the clock will also make room for figurine recovery.
Advance slightly to center alarm clock between open fingers, descend and close; inspect before lifting.
Lift closed-grasp alarm clock and carry left/back in front of drawer, checking retention while preserving joint margin.
Raise retained clock above drawer lip and move left, gently shallowing the wrist to preserve elbow-up joint margin.
After guard, use smaller lift increments and a shallower wrist to gain joint margin while positioning clock near drawer top.
Raise clock clear of the drawer's front lip and move over the top, with small increments and a shallower wrist.
After guard, lower rather than extend farther. Set clock on drawer top and open fingers, then inspect settling.
Withdraw open gripper from placed clock, then approach tipped figurine from the front for recovery without disturbing keyboard.
Clock fell from the drawer lip. Reapproach it from the front with a shallower grasp, allowing placement farther onto the top without high wrist folding.
Lower shallow open gripper to clock sides, close while keeping its upright orientation, and pause before lifting.
The shallow closure appears short of the clock sides. Reopen, insert slightly deeper, close, and test a small lift.
Shallow grasp missed the clock. Reopen and change to the previously effective top-down approach, keeping motion continuous.
Clock is lying face-up. Lower open fingers to its side walls for a top-down grasp, then close and settle.
Lift the face-up clock with closed fingers, gradually tilting it toward upright for a deeper placement onto the drawer.
Clock was not retained. Reopen and align the gripper with its rotated side walls before another controlled descent.
Advance the aligned fingers over the clock center and lower to its side walls, then close without rotating during contact.
Test centered clock grasp with a slow straight lift; hold orientation fixed and check whether clock follows.
Clock is visually retained. Raise toward drawer height while gently shallowing the wrist, keeping a continuous elbow-up posture.
Rotate retained face-up clock toward upright while raising and backing the wrist, clearing the drawer lip without approaching the folded limit.
Carry clock farther onto the drawer top and finish rotating it upright; lower gradually before release, avoiding the front lip.
Lower upright clock onto the interior of the drawer top, release with open fingers and allow it to settle before withdrawal.
Withdraw from released clock before moving toward inverted figurine; prepare a horizontal front grasp for controlled reorientation.
Approach the inverted figurine horizontally with open fingers, lowering toward its torso while keeping clear of the monitor and drawer.
Insert the horizontal fingers around the inverted figurine's waist/legs and close slowly, preparing to lift away from the monitor.
Test waist grasp by lifting the inverted figurine and drawing it clear of the monitor before any rolling correction.
Figurine remained against the monitor. Reopen and insert the horizontal grasp farther forward and lower around the waist rather than closing short.
After contact-related guard, narrow fingers to clear the drawer wall, make a small insertion and close, then test a short lift.
Fingers closed above the narrow torso. Reopen to moderate width and lower substantially to waist height before closing, with small forward insertion.
At waist height, advance the reopened fingers farther to engage the torso rather than stopping in front, then close and inspect.
Insertion met contact short of center. Back off, shift fingers left onto the waist instead of the thigh, then close gently.
Correct for the finger offset below link6: reopen and raise the horizontal grasp to the black waist, then close at the centered lateral position.
Test the new contact by lifting and withdrawing from the monitor with fingers closed. Inspect whether the figurine follows before rolling.
The waist grasp did not retain the figurine. Switch to an open approach above the exposed base, keeping clear of the monitor.
Replan after continuity guard with small increments; center around the exposed black base and close for a rim grasp.
Test the rim grasp by a short lift and withdrawal from the monitor, holding orientation fixed and judging retention from RGB.
Rim grasp missed. Bring closed fingertips down toward the exposed upper base edge for a controlled tipping correction, checking contact before proceeding.
